hook.en: An order placed on a phone call, a confirmation by courier and a truck carrying the goods: business needs communication and transport at every step.
hook.kn: ಫೋನ್ ಕರೆಯ ಮೂಲಕ ಆರ್ಡರ್, ಅಂಚೆಯ ಮೂಲಕ ದೃಢೀಕರಣ, ಲಾರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸರಕು ಸಾಗಣೆ – ವ್ಯವಹಾರಕ್ಕೆ ಪ್ರತಿ ಹಂತದಲ್ಲೂ ಸಂಪರ್ಕ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾರಿಗೆ ಬೇಕು.

objectives.en: Explain the role of transport in business

narration.en: An order placed on a phone call, a confirmation by courier and a truck carrying the goods: business needs communication and transport at every step.

body.en: India Post provides financial facilities such as savings schemes and money orders, mail facilities such as parcels, registration and insurance of letters, and allied services such as Speed Post. Telecom services include cellular mobile, fixed line, cable services, VSAT satellite links and DTH, which beams television directly to homes through a small dish.

points.en: Post: financial, mail and allied facilities
Telecom: cellular, fixed line, cable, VSAT, DTH

Telecom services include cellular mobile, fixed line, cable services, VSAT satellite links and DTH, which beams television directly to homes through a small dish.
narration.kn: ಅಂಚೆ ಇಲಾಖೆ ಹಣಕಾಸು, ಅಂಚೆ ಮತ್ತು ಪೂರಕ ಸೇವೆಗಳನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ದೂರಸಂಪರ್ಕ ಸೇವೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಮೊಬೈಲ್, ಸ್ಥಿರ ದೂರವಾಣಿ, ಕೇಬಲ್, ವಿಸ್ಯಾಟ್ ಮತ್ತು ಡಿಟಿಎಚ್ ಸೇರಿವೆ.

body.en: Transport carries goods and people from one place to another by road, rail, water, air and pipeline. It removes the hindrance of place, widens markets, helps in specialisation and keeps prices steady by moving goods from surplus to deficit areas.

narration.kn: ಸಾರಿಗೆ ಸರಕು ಮತ್ತು ಜನರನ್ನು ಒಂದು ಸ್ಥಳದಿಂದ ಇನ್ನೊಂದಕ್ಕೆ ಸಾಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ; ಸ್ಥಳದ ಅಡಚಣೆಯನ್ನು ನಿವಾರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

problem.en: A coffee grower in Chikkamagaluru must send samples to a buyer in Chennai within two days, receive payment from him, and then move 10 tonnes of coffee. Suggest a service for each need.

steps.en: Fast, time-bound delivery of samples: Speed Post or courier.
Payment: money order or electronic bank transfer.
Moving 10 tonnes of goods: road or rail transport, which removes the hindrance of place.

answer.en: Speed Post; money order or e-transfer; road/rail transport
